sanskrit_verse:
साधुकर्मक्रियायुक्ताः सत्यधर्मपरायणाः ।
अक्रोधलोभाः शास्त्रज्ञाः सभ्याः कार्या महीभुजा ॥६२॥
transliteration: sādhukarmakriyāyuktāḥ satyadharmaparāyaṇāḥ | akrodhalobhāḥ śāstrajñāḥ sabhyāḥ kāryā mahībhujā ||62||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who are engaged in righteous action, devoted to truth and dharma, free from anger and greed, and knowledgeable in sacred texts—such persons must be appointed as members of the royal assembly.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with Satya-Dharma
Capacity-based responsibility requires inner purity and scriptural knowledge
Causation is rooted in consciousness integrity
Restoration logic demands selection of the qualified
executable_legal_axioms: IF a candidate exhibits sustained engagement in sādhu-karma THEN eligibility for sabhā membership IS affirmed
IF a candidate demonstrates attachment to truth and dharma THEN inclusion in governance bodies IS mandated
IF a candidate displays traces of krodha or lobha THEN temporary exclusion from sabhā roles IS enforced UNTIL purification protocols are completed
IF a candidate lacks śāstra-jñāna THEN mandatory education IS required BEFORE appointment
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court-level adjudication, only those judges who demonstrate unbroken alignment with Satya-Dharma, absence of personal desire, and mastery of śāstra may serve. Their qualification is not based on tenure or precedent but on consciousness-readiness and dharmic discernment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that righteous conduct and scriptural insight are causal prerequisites for judicial authority. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that misalignment in sabhā leads to societal disorder. Responsibility is proportional to spiritual and ethical capacity. Justice is non-punitive when it ensures only the qualified participate in judgment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Conduct regular śāstra-adhyayana for sabhā members to maintain śāstra-jñāna
Implement daily sādhu-karma tracking to ensure alignment with dharmic duties
Establish monthly svādhyāya and pratikramana sessions to neutralize krodha-lopa influences
Introduce consciousness assessment protocols before reappointment to sabhā positions
final_declaration: By the authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this directive originates. Dharma is restored through the conscious selection of sabhā members. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the final adjudicator.
